items.title: Base change of immersions: surjectivity of the conormal comparison map and its flat case isomorphism
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms of Spaces)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file spaces-more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: In a fibre product diagram of algebraic spaces with i and i' immersions, the canonical map f^*C_{Z'/X'} -> C_{Z/X} of the plain functoriality lemma is always surjective, and is an isomorphism when g is flat. The proof is a written descent argument: choose an etale surjective presentation of the diagram by schemes (with the existence lemma cited), use the etale-conormal and conormal-functorial-more lemmas to reduce the question to schemes, and cite the schemes case of the flat base change statement in Morphisms. Retained author proof at lines 572-588.
